guidance: Navigate to an available cooking appliance first. If the target cooking vessel is observed there, take it. If not, fall back to inspecting available open horizontal surfaces, then closed storage receptacles. Stop searching as soon as the target is observed.
hypothesis: For cooking vessels requiring downstream cooling, prioritizing navigation to cooking appliances (e.g., stove burners) before inspecting general open horizontal surfaces or closed storage receptacles reduces total search actions by targeting semantically likely spawn locations first.

probe_spec.adaptive_policy: From the entry state, select an available cooking appliance from the admissible actions and navigate to it. Inspect the resulting observation for the target cooking vessel. If found, take it and terminate the search. If not found, select an available open horizontal surface and navigate to it, repeating the inspection. If still not found, select a closed storage receptacle, navigate to it, open it, and inspect. Terminate immediately upon first target observation.
probe_spec.evidence_goal: Whether navigating to a cooking appliance first yields the target cooking vessel in fewer total search actions than starting with open horizontal surfaces or closed storage receptacles.
probe_spec.local_function: Search environment receptacles to locate and acquire the target pan object.
probe_spec.realization_pattern: visit a cooking appliance first; if empty, visit an open horizontal surface next; if still empty, visit a closed storage receptacle, opening it before inspection
probe_spec.required_downstream_state: Pan held in agent inventory, ready for downstream cooling routine.
stop_conditions: Target cooking vessel is observed and taken
All cooking appliances have been inspected without finding the target
An action fails or is not admissible
Maximum of three distinct receptacle categories visited without success

reason: Previous exploration tested appliance-first search only for food items. This probe tests whether the same semantic heuristic applies to cooking vessels like pans, which are strongly associated with stove burners rather than countertops or cabinets, representing a materially different scope and realization context.
scope: ALFWorld pick-cool-then-place tasks where the target object is a cooking vessel (e.g., pan, pot) not immediately visible in the entry observation and the room contains both open horizontal surfaces, closed storage receptacles, and cooking appliances.

public_capability_evidence: go to stoveburner_1 is present in entry_state_capabilities.currently_admissible_actions
source_grounding.why_grounded: stoveburner_1 is listed in the currently_admissible_actions at the entry state and represents a cooking appliance relevant to the target cooking vessel.
